method: Strict blind assertion grading; omission is not evidence

evidence: Data-export is explicitly rejected as the automatic owner.
Startup and active-learning responsibilities are compared.
The user must resolve the resulting ambiguity.
The proposal explicitly precedes every write.

failed_evidence: Ownership is assigned without surfacing ambiguity.
The response does not require the proposal to precede every write.

evidence: The cache is discovery-only.
Repository and skill path are resolved before import.
Import-skill freshens and pins the source.
Import precedes adaptation.
A competing skill is explicitly rejected.

failed_evidence: It proposes an upstream contribution rather than import-skill.
No freshening or project-copy adaptation is described.
A competing project skill is not explicitly ruled out.

evidence: Unresolved provenance stops the workflow.
The user is asked for the authoritative repository and path.
The cache cannot be copied or edited.
A competing skill cannot be created.
The umbrella submodule checkout is explicitly excluded.
The change is handed to the owning repository worktree after approval.
The recording remains claimed until verification.
Approval precedes handoff.

failed_evidence: It does not preserve the active recording in end phase until verification.

evidence: All searched skill surfaces are named as evidence.
Create-skill is the proposed disposition.
A concrete trigger and responsibility boundary are shown.
Explicit approval gates creation.
Nothing is created during disposition.

failed_evidence: No concrete trigger or boundary is shown.

evidence: The temporary port is explicitly rejected as one-off.
No edit or new skill is proposed.
No validation is invented.
Compare-and-close uses the exact ID, claim, and revision.

failed_evidence: It does not explicitly classify the port as one-off.
